steps.title: Grouping, regions, coverage renderer, Sinkhorn and LS objectives (work item 1)
steps.result: Coverage mass on stock-rendered lit pixels at the truth: median 99.6% (min 95.2%) over 20 grad grains; truth map groups into exactly the 497 grains; Sinkhorn at truth 0.4-0.7 px^2 after component + ratio filters and reach 3 px.

steps.title: Objective bias: where each objective's minimum sits against the truth
steps.result: Smoke test: stage A lowered Sinkhorn while moving voxels 0.016 to 0.050 deg away from the truth (strict-cost gate rejected).

pareto_note: Share of voxels above 0.1 deg against renders per voxel (grain-objective evaluations, or strict evaluations per voxel for per-voxel fits). Reference points are on all 19,013 painted voxels of grad; G20 points on the voxels of the 20 benchmark grains that have a C record.
